ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast; approximately 65% high-intensity white/off-white pixels to 35% low-intensity black/dark-grey pixels on the visible ventral surface of the upright lobe.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant white central field on the upright lobe. Dense dark pigmentation is concentrated along the trailing edge and base. A series of vertical dark linear streaks are distributed across the central white area. A distinct, isolated dark circular ring feature is mapped in the lower-mid quadrant of the upright lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular micro-serrations along the trailing edge of the upright lobe with varying pixel-amplitudes of 3-12 pixels; topographical noise increases significantly at the tip due to high-contrast barnacle clusters.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The outer margin of the upright lobe follows a continuous convex arc from the base, flattening into a neutral trajectory toward the terminal tip.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Concentrated clusters of high-contrast, textured yellowish-white pixels (barnacles) localized at the terminal tips of both lobes and along the distal leading edge of the submerged lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple dark, unaligned vertical linear disruptions (rake marks) cutting through the white pigmentation field on the upright lobe; lighter, horizontal-oriented linear marks are visible on the submerged lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy barnacle colonization at the terminal tips; a singular circular dark pigmentation anomaly or scar on the white ventral field.
other_distinctive_markers: A highly distinctive dark circular ring-like marker located mid-ventral on the upright lobe lobe.
